page.layout: One blank page: no printed text. Only a dark stamp near the centre and show-through at the edges, which are left out.
page.notes: Blank leaf, a parchment-like wrapper or endleaf. The dark stamp in the centre (a shield-shaped mark) is an ownership or library stamp and is not transcribed. Faint marks at the top and left edge are show-through from the other side of the leaf. Ties and sewing holes at the left and right edges belong to the binding.
